_: The pairing code: 120 bits of platform randomness written so a person can retype it once. Twenty-four Crockford base32 characters and a Luhn mod 32 check, in groups of five. These vectors were produced by a SECOND implementation (a big integer sliced from the top, rather than core's bit accumulator) so that a bug in one would not be written down here as the answer.
_accepts: A code is read off a screen and typed by hand, so the shape it arrives in is not the shape it was shown in. All of these are the same secret as codes[3].
_rejects: What a person must be TOLD about rather than left to discover as a connection that never opens.
